machineRules: Footprint must stay within a 5.2 × 5.2 m bounding square centred at (0, 0, 0) and height under 6.0 m.
Maximum 3 meshes per machine: merged body (toon vertex colours), merged glow (unlit emissive), and one animated pivot.
Floor-level origin: (0, 0, 0) is the ground centre slab; +Y is vertical up, +Z is front facing the yard/path.
Standardised loading bays: input hopper / intake pile sits front-left at [-1.6, 2.6], output pile sits front-right at [1.6, 2.6].
Cosy toy-diorama proportions: bevelled silhouettes, rounded corners, chunky forms readable from a 45° isometric camera at 25 m distance.
Procedural low-poly primitives only: box, cylinder, cone, sphere, torus, capsule merged into single draw calls.
Generous snow blankets: top-facing roofs and horizontal ledges carry rounded caps in snow white #f4f7fb with overhang drips.
Warm interior life: every machine has a lit window, glow vent, or furnace aperture to ensure no era feels cold, menacing, or abandoned.
Cycle-driven animation: the single 'pivot' mesh spins, bobs, or swings during active production and drops to a gentle idle crawl when quiet.
Zero per-frame runtime allocations: uses shared vertex-colour material (vcMat) and shared registered emissive material (eraGlowMaterial).

iconStyle: Icons are drawn as 64×64 pixel crisp flat vector illustrations framed on a soft rounded square tile tinted with the era's ground color and a clean 2 px inner rim. Subjects are rendered in high-readability 3/4 isometric perspective with bold 2 px dark silhouette contours, 3 distinct cel-shaded tone steps, and no gradients or micro-noise. All assets feature a cozy toy-diorama charm with soft rounded corners, warm natural materials harmonised with snow (#f4f7fb), pine (#2f6b3f), timber (#8a5a3b), and gold (#e8b341), topped with a clean 3 px white specular glint in the upper-left quadrant.
